9// ============================================================
10// PhotonTransition
11// ============================================================
12//
13// Represents one gamma deexcitation transition from an initial
14// nuclear level to a lower daughter level.
15//
16// This corresponds to one gamma line in the Geant4
17// PhotonEvaporation level-gamma data file.
18//
19
20struct PhotonTransition
21{
22    // --------------------------------------------------------
23    // Daughter level
24    // --------------------------------------------------------
25
26    int daughterLevel;
27
28    // --------------------------------------------------------
29    // Gamma transition properties
30    // --------------------------------------------------------
31
32    double energy_keV;
33    double relativeIntensity;
34
35    // Geant4 multipolarity encoding:
36    //
37    //   1 = E0
38    //   2 = E1
39    //   3 = M1
40    //   4 = E2
41    //   5 = M2
42    //   6 = E3
43    //   7 = M3
44    //
45    //   100*Nx + Ny = mixed transition
46    //
47    // Example:
48    //   304 = M1 + E2
49    //
50    //   0 = unknown multipolarity
51    //
52
53    int multipolarity;
54
55    // --------------------------------------------------------
56    // Multipolarity mixing ratio
57    // --------------------------------------------------------
58    //
59    // Geant4 uses 0 when no mixing ratio is given in the
60    // numerical representation of the data.
61    //
62    // The original file description refers to this as "O"
63    // (not given) in the conceptual format.
64    //
65
66    double mixingRatio;
67
68    // --------------------------------------------------------
69    // Internal conversion
70    // --------------------------------------------------------
71    //
72    // alpha = Ic / Ig
73    //
74
75    double conversionCoefficient;
76
77    // --------------------------------------------------------
78    // Partial internal conversion probabilities
79    // --------------------------------------------------------
80    //
81    // Ordered according to the Geant4 documentation:
82    //
83    //   [0] K
84    //   [1] L1
85    //   [2] L2
86    //   [3] L3
87    //   [4] M1
88    //   [5] M2
89    //   [6] M3
90    //   [7] M4
91    //   [8] M5
92    //   [9] Outer shells
93    //
94    // These values are zero when the total conversion
95    // coefficient is zero or when no partial data are given.
96    //
97
98    std::array<double, 10> shellConversionProbabilities{};
99
100    // --------------------------------------------------------
101    // Constructors
102    // --------------------------------------------------------
103
104    PhotonTransition();
105
106    PhotonTransition(
107        int daughterLevel,
108        double energy_keV,
109        double relativeIntensity,
110        int multipolarity,
111        double mixingRatio,
112        double conversionCoefficient,
113        const std::array<double, 10>& shellConversionProbabilities
114    );
115
116    // --------------------------------------------------------
117    // Probability helpers
118    // --------------------------------------------------------
119
120    // Probability that the transition proceeds by gamma
121    // emission rather than internal conversion.
122    //
123    // P(gamma) = 1 / (1 + alpha)
124    //
125    double gammaProbability() const;
126
127    // Probability that the transition proceeds by internal
128    // conversion.
129    //
130    // P(IC) = alpha / (1 + alpha)
131    //
132    double conversionProbability() const;
133};

136// ============================================================
137// PhotonLevel
138// ============================================================
139//
140// Represents one nuclear level in a PhotonEvaporation isotope
141// file.
142//
143
144struct PhotonLevel
145{
146    // --------------------------------------------------------
147    // Level identification
148    // --------------------------------------------------------
149
150    int id;
151
152    // --------------------------------------------------------
153    // Floating-level flag
154    // --------------------------------------------------------
155    //
156    // Geant4 level files contain values such as:
157    //
158    //   -
159    //   +X
160    //   +Y
161    //   +Z
162    //   +U
163    //   ...
164    //
165    // We preserve this field as a string rather than attempting
166    // to interpret it at the reader level.
167    //
168
169    std::string floating;
170
171    // --------------------------------------------------------
172    // Level properties
173    // --------------------------------------------------------
174
175    double energy_keV;
176
177    // Level half-life in seconds.
178    //
179    // Geant4 uses -1 for a stable ground state.
180    //
181
182    double halfLife_s;
183
184    // --------------------------------------------------------
185    // JPi information
186    // --------------------------------------------------------
187    //
188    // The sign encodes parity.
189    //
190    // 99 indicates that JPi is unknown.
191    //
192
193    double jpi;
194
195    // --------------------------------------------------------
196    // Gamma deexcitation transitions
197    // --------------------------------------------------------
198
199    std::vector<PhotonTransition> transitions;
200
201    // --------------------------------------------------------
202    // Constructors
203    // --------------------------------------------------------
204
205    PhotonLevel();
206
207    PhotonLevel(
208        int id,
209        const std::string& floating,
210        double energy_keV,
211        double halfLife_s,
212        double jpi
213    );
214
215    // --------------------------------------------------------
216    // Queries
217    // --------------------------------------------------------
218
219    std::size_t numberOfGammas() const;
220
221    bool isStable() const;
222
223    bool hasKnownJPi() const;
224};

231// Represents the complete PhotonEvaporation data for one

241//
242
243class PhotonIsotope
244{
245public:
246
247    // --------------------------------------------------------
248    // Constructor
249    // --------------------------------------------------------
250
251    PhotonIsotope();
252
253    PhotonIsotope(
254        int atomicNumber,
255        int massNumber
256    );
257
258    // --------------------------------------------------------
259    // Isotope identification
260    // --------------------------------------------------------
261
262    int atomicNumber() const;
263
264    int massNumber() const;
265
266    // --------------------------------------------------------
267    // Level access
268    // --------------------------------------------------------
269
270    const std::vector<PhotonLevel>& levels() const;
271
272    std::vector<PhotonLevel>& levels();
273
274    std::size_t numberOfLevels() const;
275
276    // --------------------------------------------------------
277    // Level lookup
278    // --------------------------------------------------------
279
280    const PhotonLevel& level(int id) const;
281
282    PhotonLevel& level(int id);
283
284    // --------------------------------------------------------
285    // Add level
286    // --------------------------------------------------------
287
288    void addLevel(const PhotonLevel& level);
289
290private:
291
292    int fAtomicNumber;
293    int fMassNumber;
294
295    std::vector<PhotonLevel> fLevels;
296};

299// ============================================================
300// PhotonEvaporationReader
301// ============================================================
302//
303// Reader for the Geant4 PhotonEvaporation level-gamma database.
304//
305// Example:
306//
307//     PhotonEvaporationReader reader(
308//         "PhotonEvaporation5.5"
309//     );
310//
311//     PhotonIsotope na22 = reader.read(11, 22);
312//
313
314class PhotonEvaporationReader
315{
316public:
317
318    // --------------------------------------------------------
319    // Constructor
320    // --------------------------------------------------------
321
322    explicit PhotonEvaporationReader(
323        const std::string& dataDirectory
324    );
325
326    // --------------------------------------------------------
327    // Read isotope
328    // --------------------------------------------------------
329    //
330    // Reads:
331    //
332    //     <dataDirectory>/z<Z>.a<A>
333    //
334    // For example:
335    //
336    //     read(11, 22)
337    //
338    // reads:
339    //
340    //     PhotonEvaporation5.5/z11.a22
341    //
342
343    PhotonIsotope read(
344        int atomicNumber,
345        int massNumber
346    ) const;
347
348    // --------------------------------------------------------
349    // File path
350    // --------------------------------------------------------
351    //
352    // Returns the expected path for an isotope data file.
353    //
354
355    std::string filePath(
356        int atomicNumber,
357        int massNumber
358    ) const;
359
360    // --------------------------------------------------------
361    // Data directory
362    // --------------------------------------------------------
363
364    const std::string& dataDirectory() const;
365
366private:
367
368    std::string fDataDirectory;
369
370    // --------------------------------------------------------
371    // Parsing helpers
372    // --------------------------------------------------------
373
374    PhotonLevel parseLevel(
375        const std::string& line
376    ) const;
377
378    PhotonTransition parseTransition(
379        const std::string& line
380    ) const;
381};
